subject: The secret truth about your dog's first 2 weeks
preview_text: I discovered something about your dog's progress that changes everything. You need to see this.
body_paragraphs: I was looking at the data from the last 14 days. And honestly? I had to double-check it. Because what you've done for your dog in just two weeks is the part most people never talk about.

Think about it. For 14 days, you've made conscious choices. You've measured meals, maybe swapped a treat for a belly rub, and started a new routine. That's HUGE. That's the foundation the 15% weight loss stories are built on. You've already done the hardest part: starting. Most dogs never get that.

And all that effort? It's waiting for you in the Progress Tracker. I built the 'Before/After Photo Timeline' not just for the finish line, but for moments like right now. To show you the subtle changes—the extra spring in their step, the easier time on walks—that the scale might not scream about yet.

Open the app and add a 'Week 2' photo to your timeline. Do it right now, before you forget the feeling of starting. Trust me, in 6 weeks, you'll look back at today's photo and be stunned. P.S. The dogs who use the photo timeline are 3x more likely to hit their goal weight. It's not magic. It's proof.
